name: unobserved_relocation_then_sighting
basis: synthetic scenario, authored by the tester 2026-10-10; software-correctness expectations, not accuracy
description: Part 1 section 10 case 2 (out of view) and the fidelity/usefulness split: the remote is placed on the counter, then moved to the drawer during a screen lock. Asked after the gap, the system hedges with the old place and the coverage_gap reason (coordinator ruling 2): hedged-wrong for usefulness, fidelity ok (the photo was true for its time). An idle still then shows the counter empty (negative re-observation): the old place is reported as history (hedged-correct, coverage_gap still listed). A later observed placement in the drawer answers confidently.
